verses.text: A song of ascents. Of David.My heart is not proud, O LORD,my eyes are not haughty.I do not aspire to great thingsor matters too lofty for me.
verses.heading: I Have Stilled My Soul

verses.text: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul;like a weaned child with his mother,like a weaned child is my soul within me.
O Israel, put your hope in the LORD,both now and forevermore.
